records.subject: Andrea di Bartolo, Nativity of the Virgin, NGA 1939.1.42
records.findingEn: New high-resolution exact-image route bypasses the inaccessible NGA IIIF host: NGA-donated Wikimedia Commons file, 2957 × 4000 px, 14.12 MB, deposited 13 August 2019, identifies NGA accession 1939.1.42 and NGA as source/provider; metadata asserts CC0. This is an NGA-origin derivative rather than a visitor photo. Do not count as acquired until bytes, hash and mobile composition are inspected.
records.findingFr: Une reproduction exacte de la NGA, versée sur Wikimedia Commons le 13 août 2019, mesure 2 957 × 4 000 pixels (14,12 Mo). La provenance NGA et la déclaration CC0 sont explicites. L'acquisition, le hachage et le contrôle de cadrage mobile restent à réaliser.

records.subject: Stefan Lochner, Martyrdom of Ss Simon and Judas, Städel inventory 830
records.findingEn: A previously unlogged full-resolution exact-image route on Commons holds a 7799 × 7712 px, 108.16 MB PNG, uploaded 25 November 2020 as a Städel museum upload. The Commons page displays Public Domain Mark from the institution, but embedded EXIF copyright and structured-data CC BY-SA claims conflict. Treat museum object-page Public Domain designation as the stronger institutional evidence, while documenting the conflicting metadata and resolving it before selecting an exact downloadable derivative. Large original may require a smaller QA derivative.
records.findingFr: Une reproduction PNG exacte de 7 799 × 7 712 pixels (108,16 Mo), déposée le 25 novembre 2020 à partir du Städel, est repérée. Le marquage Public Domain du musée coexiste avec des métadonnées EXIF et structurées contradictoires. Conserver cette divergence avant toute promotion.

records.subject: Andrea di Bartolo, Nativity of the Virgin, independent visitor photo
records.findingEn: A separate 3240 × 4320 px image photographed by Daderot on 24 April 2013 is explicitly dedicated CC0 by the photographer. Keep separate from NGA-donated exact reproduction; independent photo may introduce framing and lighting distortion. Backup only.
records.findingFr: Une photographie indépendante de Daderot (24 avril 2013), 3 240 × 4 320 pixels, est diffusée sous CC0. Il s'agit d'une source distincte de la reproduction institutionnelle NGA, à conserver comme solution de repli.
